title: Warm Spiced Dolma Stuffed Vegetables
description: A delicious and healthy Turkish-inspired dish where vegetables are stuffed with a warm spiced dolma filling.
instructions: Cut the tops off the bell peppers and remove the seeds and membranes.
In a pan, sauté the onion and garlic until softened.
Add the warm spiced dolma, tomato, and rice to the pan. Cook for 2-3 minutes.
Stuff each bell pepper with the dolma mixture and top with parsley.
Place the stuffed peppers in a baking dish and cover with foil.
Bake for 25-30 minutes or until the peppers are tender.
Serve warm, garnished with additional parsley if desired.
